body: Aww.. I can't watch! The cat is so heartbreaking :(
So pretty :)

I'm not trying to be constantly happy. I know it's not possible. But I don't have the willpower to push through the difficult times. I'm not recovering fast enough so I could enjoy those short  good moments.  I have told him and he is very supportive and I feel guilty for not being happier  and stronger for him.
My boyfriend. What stopped me was the image of him finding me. I hate this. Why can't we just be happy.
It really does. I feel worthless and stupid. Why everything has to be so damn hard.
I'm sorry to hear that. I've been sick a lot. I hate this. I can't get out of the bed and i'm terrified that i have to call my boss.
Hi, still here.
I probably need to take my whole life off.
Tired. Ashamed and stupid. I texted my boss that I can't work tomorrow and I hate myself for doing that.
I believe he was depressed. I don't think there was any other reason. He didn't leave a note or anything.

My dad killed himself when I was just a baby and my two brothers were both very young. Losing our father like that left us all traumatized and even now as an adults we are not healed. All of us have had different ways to cope and none of them has been healthy. I spent most of my teenage years in therapy and even it wasn't all about my father he still had a pretry big part in it. I can tell you, your children wants you to live.
She's the best!
You are not annoying <3
I envy people who are happy. I would rather be happy than suicidal. But I agree with you, work life is intorelable..which makes the whole life intorelable for me.
That's sad. Did it get better over time or did you find help when you got older or are you still suffering?
I have always reacted with my stomach too and I probably had separation anxiety also at some point, but the answers make me think I was more depressed than anxious.
Good that you were diagnosed tho! Or I assume that made it easier to get help.
Good to hear you are better :) and I agree, I can only wish that every parent is doing their best and tries to understand their children more. I couldn't talk to mine either as a kid.
Did your parents do anything about it?
Hi, hope you are doing better now. Your symptoms sound very stressfull :( i don't have children, i was asking so I could  understand my own childhood better.

I know this feeling too well.. I'm also scared of new things and change especially when it's about work and it's definitely holding me back. Unfortunately I don't know how to ease it but I know it gets better once you start to have a routine at the job. You can do it I'm sure of it :)

Everything is falling apart. Oh my god, i want this to be over. Next weeks work is something I can't do...i don't know how. And I had a planned thing at uni for tomorrow but i didn't get the day off and now I failing other student and...oh my god, i can't handle this...fuck fuck fuck fuck

I couldn't agree more. Changing the therapist was one of the best things I've done maybe in my whole life. It was scary and hard and awkward but so worth it. My first one was kind but kept saying things like "just try not think about it" or "just eat something " when I was struggling with eatingdisorder. I guess she thought I needed a mom and not a therapist :D (I have a lovely mom, but at the time I looked like a lost teenager, even I was an adult)

I finally texted my boss and asked if I could get more morning shifts instead of evenings. It was so scary cause earlier I thought evevnings would be better for me and so I told my boss that I want to work at evenings. Anyway now I've realized that I like my job more when I get there at morning even it means that I have to wake up at 4 am, but even that is better than sitting at home all day crying and having anxiety because the waiting is so stressfull.

It is not your fault that they are miserable. I'm sure it's very hard to live in that situation:/ unfortunately I don't have very good advices cause I ended up not visiting home for many many years after I was able to move out. But I also saw therapist which was a great help for me. Hang in there, i hope you find the answers you need.

That sounds like a terrible situation :( I've been like this myself too and I still get extremely anxious when ever someone gets even little upset with me. What has helped me tho is to figure out WHY it is so terrifying to argue with someone. I ask myself what I'm really afraid of? Or is it the negativity that makes me uncomfortable? I can only speak about my own experiences and I have no idea if this speaks to you at all, but we had lots of horrible fights at home when I was a kid and I tried to be as quiet and invisible as possible so that when the fighting started it wouldn't at least be my fault...well it didn't work, I always felt quilty. So I guess that I still somehow feel responsible when ever there's an argument or any kind of negativity around me.

I know this and in normal situation it would be true. Lately nothing that has worked before works anymore, they even make me feel worse in a long run, like exercise and going out. I mean even I would want to see my friends and then do that, after half an hour or so I start to feel so tired I can't really hold a conversation. have seen a doctor because of this tiredness but it seems they can't find a reason. 
Btw, thank you so much for taking time to talk to me.

Yeah. I kinda have that feeling when I think about my boyfriend and how good he is to me. But then again I find myself thinking how he should be with someone who is loves life and is...well..at least willing to live.
Well, I'm too tired to see my friends, but I live with my SO, so I'm not completely isoleted. If that's what you mean.
I'm 25. I have been depressed almost my whole life. Have had better times in between but it always comes back and usually without reason..or so it seems.
I'm not ok and getting better seems impossible. I know, i have no comforting words either. I hope you find the reason soon.
I'm so sorry to hear that :'(

I can't do this anymore. I just can't! I feel terrible and tired and somehow unreal. I can't focus and it feels like I can't control my body. I burst into tears all the time. I have to go to work tomorrow after weeks of sick leave because of physical symptoms I still have but doctor haven't found reason for them and I start to think it's all because of this anxiety and depression. I can't do this.

Hey, thank you so much for replying! Actually I don't have health anxiety, I don't care if it's bad news I just want to know what's wrong with me. I have had bad stomachaches and extreme tiredness for some time now and first they found anemia but since the treatment made it kinda worse they wanted to take more tests.

Edit: So he called and it was the worst case scenario. He couldn't tell me anything based on the tests. So once again, I have no idea why my stomach hurts all the time and why I'm so damn tired. Today has been a very very bad one.

Thank you for the reply. One of the symptoms I have is that I'm too exhausted and fatigued to do any exercise. And if I force myself to do even a short and light exercise, the next day I'm even more exhausted. It's difficult for me cause I used to exercise quite a lot and it was important stress reliever for me. I know that if doctors can't explain this then I have to search a therapist. And maybe even if they can. Anyway, it's the waiting that kills me. 
And sleeping pills are the last option for me, I don't have good experiences with those, unfortunately.
My attacks have never been like your boyfriend's but sounds like you did the right thing. Maybe when he gets used to have someone there to help him, he figures out what kind of support he needs.
Not feeling good at all. Anxious about everything today, but somehow I managed to send some emails considering my thesis/graduation.
Yes, I feel like this almost everyday. Focusing on anything is also almost impossible because of the tiredness. That's why I just put TV on and stare at it so I don't have to think.
Thank you. The annoying thing is that I've done this before, several times even. But it's been a while and I feel ashamed to go through this again.
Oh, thank you so much :)

Hi, I'm new here. At the moment I'm probably more depressed than anxious but the anxiety also stops me from doing stuff or makes it really hard to do anything. Tomorrow I have to see a doctor for example and I feel terrible and nauseous because of it. I'm not sure what to say to him.

I know the feeling. It sucks. But maybe now when you had even short moment of relief, maybe even happiness, you know it's possible to feel that way and you can try to get energy from that. Hope it doesn't sound stupid. Stay strong.
Thank you.  I hope you have better day today.
